flows.name: Agents automate a regulated process on cnext's Kairos, and a person reviews what they flag (cnext)
flows.summary: cnext's home page, in its own terms and its KYC example: cnext decides with the client what is worth automating, builds the automation on Kairos, its agentic platform, which runs in the client's own cloud; the agents flag what needs a person (an incomplete form), and the person confirms.

steps.what: Choose which processes are worth automating (KYC, fraud detection, reconciliation, regulatory reporting) and what the return will be.
Builds the automation on Kairos, which runs in the client's own cloud, built around GDPR and the AI Act.
Work through the case, for example a KYC form, and flag what they cannot settle ("Unreadable text in Section 3").
steps.agent: Process the case and flag what needs a person.

steps.what: Reviews the flagged item and confirms the data.
